Name: Infrahub
Desc: OpsMill Infrahub 1.11.9, a graph-based infrastructure source of truth with branches and versioned schemas, deployed like its production docker-compose: infrahub-server (gunicorn, 4 API workers) behind the infrahub-server Service, two Prefect task-worker pods that run Infrahub's background flows, the Prefect task-manager with its PostgreSQL database (task-manager-db), Neo4j (database), RabbitMQ (message-queue) and Redis (cache). The inventory-sync service records the network team's devices (NetworkDevice) and their modules (NetworkModule) in Infrahub through the GraphQL API. {changes} The admin API token is in the infrahub-credentials Secret (key admin-token); send it as the X-INFRAHUB-KEY header.
Supported Operations: Create and read NetworkDevice and NetworkModule objects through GraphQL (POST /graphql/main)
Create, change and merge branches (BranchCreate, BranchMerge)
Run Infrahub's maintenance CLI (infrahub ...) inside the server or worker pods
